name: Senior Software Engineer
description: Designs architecture, writes production-quality code, conducts code reviews, and mentors team members across any language or framework.

name: QA Engineer
description: Designs and executes test strategies including unit, integration, E2E, and performance tests to ensure software quality.

name: Technical Lead
description: Leads technical decisions, coordinates cross-team delivery, and ensures architectural consistency across the SDLC.

name: DevOps Engineer
description: Designs and maintains CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and cloud infrastructure to enable continuous delivery.

name: Security Engineer
description: Performs security assessments, implements secure coding practices, and ensures compliance with organisational security policies.

name: Business Analyst
description: Translates business requirements into actionable technical specifications and acceptance criteria.

name: Solution Architect
description: Defines high-level system design, technology choices, and integration patterns aligned with enterprise standards.

name: Data Engineer
description: Designs and builds data pipelines, manages ETL workflows, and ensures data integrity across storage systems.
